invariants.description: static map sigma = G_Rsp ln(max(f_esp - f_es_min + 1, 1))
invariants.expr: np.max(np.abs(sigma_Rsp - (np.where(f_esp >= f_es_min, G_Rsp*np.log(f_esp - f_es_min + 1), 0.0)))) <= 1e-9 * max(1.0, np.max(np.abs(sigma_Rsp)))

invariants.description: Delta_Rsp matches the exact first-order step response sigma (1 - exp(-t/tau_Rsp))
invariants.expr: np.max(np.abs(Delta_Rsp - (np.where(f_esp >= f_es_min, G_Rsp*np.log(f_esp - f_es_min + 1), 0.0)*(1 - np.exp(-t/tau_Rsp))))) <= 1e-4 * max(1.0, np.max(np.abs(Delta_Rsp)))

bc_sweep.rationale: f_esp 0-60 Hz spans silent to maximal sympathetic firing (f_es,max = 60 Hz in Ursino 2000) and crosses f_es_min where the map switches; tau_Rsp 1-30 s covers the csv value and the Gee Simulink value; gain x0.5-x2.

baseline.reason: effector gain/time constant of a reflex arm; component-level response (e.g. peripheral resistance or unstressed volume change after a step in sympathetic firing) is not available as data here; validation belongs to the closed-loop model.

calibrate.note: not_applicable: effector gain/time constant of a reflex arm; component-level response (e.g. peripheral resistance or unstressed volume change after a step in sympathetic firing) is not available as data here; validation belongs to the closed-loop model.
